# Copilot Instructions — cloudlandscape

Static directory of European sovereign cloud providers. Built with **Zola** (Rust SSG), **Tera** templates, vanilla CSS/JS. Deployed to GitHub Pages. Bilingual: French (default) + English.

**Zero runtime server. Zero Node.js. Zero CSS/JS frameworks.** Every page is pre-generated at build time from TOML frontmatter + Markdown. Client-side filtering and search operate entirely on inline JSON embedded by Zola at build time.

## Commands

```bash
mise run build       # Build site → public/
mise run serve       # Build then start dev server on localhost:1111 (hot reload)
mise run check       # Validate internal links (zola check)
mise run validate    # Validate provider YAML against JSON schema
mise run a11y        # axe-core accessibility tests (requires serve to be running)
mise run lighthouse  # Lighthouse CI audit
mise run test        # Full suite: validate + check + a11y + lighthouse
mise run stop        # Stop dev server
```

Run a single provider validation:
```bash
uv run docs/validate_providers.py  # validates all providers; exit code 1 on any error
```

## Architecture

### Content → Pages (Zola SSG)

- Provider data lives entirely in **TOML frontmatter** of `content/providers/{slug}/index.md` (FR) and `index.en.md` (EN). No separate data files.
- Zola generates pages at build time from frontmatter + Markdown body. Zero runtime server.
- Three **native Zola taxonomies** — `services`, `certifications`, `countries` — auto-generate filtered listing pages from provider `[taxonomies]` blocks.
- `content/certifications/{slug}.md` / `.en.md` — rich explainer pages for certifications (SecNumCloud, HDS, EUCS).

### Template Lookup Order (critical)

Zola resolves templates with specificity — always create the specific one first:

| URL pattern | Template used |
|-------------|---------------|
| Any page in `content/providers/` | `templates/providers/page.html` → `templates/page.html` |
| Any page in `content/certifications/` | `templates/certifications/page.html` → `templates/page.html` |
| Taxonomy term (e.g. `/certifications/secnumcloud/`) | `templates/certifications/single.html` → `templates/taxonomy_single.html` |
| Section index (e.g. `/providers/`) | `templates/providers/section.html` → `templates/section.html` |

All templates extend `templates/base.html` via `{% extends "base.html" %}`.

### Client-Side Filtering and Search

Provider data is embedded at build time as inline JSON in a `<script id="providers-data" type="application/json">` tag, generated by `templates/partials/providers-json-data.html`. **This partial must be included in both `templates/providers/section.html` and `templates/compare/section.html`** — never create a separate JSON file.

Read it in JS with: `JSON.parse(document.getElementById('providers-data').textContent)`

Full-text search uses **Elasticlunr.js** (built into Zola, no npm install needed) — the search index is generated automatically when `build_search_index = true` in `zola.toml`.

`static/compare.html` is a **standalone static HTML file** (not a Zola template). It does not inherit `base.html` and must manage its own landmarks, skip link, lang attribute, and `<script>` for lang detection from `localStorage`.

**Progressive enhancement**: all provider content must be readable without JavaScript. JS only enhances filtering, comparison, and search.

### Language System

- Default language: `fr`. English pages are at `/en/...`.
- In Tera: `{{ lang }}` gives current language (`"fr"` or `"en"`). Use `{{ trans(key="my_key", lang=lang) }}` for all UI strings.
- All i18n keys are in `zola.toml` under `[languages.fr.translations]` and `[languages.en.translations]`.
- Client-side lang preference: `localStorage.getItem('cloudlandscape_lang')` — key used in `static/lang.js`, `static/compare.html`, and `static/mobile.js`.

## Key Conventions

### Provider Frontmatter

Uses **TOML** syntax (not YAML — delimited by `+++`). See `docs/provider-template.yaml` for the full annotated template including all valid service/certification values and optional fields. Schema enforced by `docs/provider-schema.json`.

All frontmatter keys use `snake_case`. Taxonomy slugs are always `kebab-case`. **Never invent new taxonomy names** — they must be declared in `zola.toml` under each `[languages.*.taxonomies]` block first.

Run `mise run validate` after any frontmatter change.

### Section vs Page Content Files

- **Section index**: `_index.md` / `_index.en.md` (underscore prefix is mandatory in Zola)
- **Page**: `index.md` / `index.en.md`
- Access a section's pages in Tera: `get_section(path="providers/_index.md")` — always use the FR (default) path.

### JavaScript

Four JS files, all vanilla IIFEs — no bundler, no framework:
- `filter.js` — provider listing filter + search
- `compare.js` — comparison table rendering
- `lang.js` — language switcher (`switchLanguage(lang)`)
- `mobile.js` — filter panel toggle + Escape key handler

Naming conventions, budgets, and DOM rules: `_bmad-output/project-context.md` lines 53–60.

### CSS

Single file: `static/style.css`. Design tokens are CSS custom properties (`--color-*`, `--spacing-*`, `--font-*` namespaces). Class names: `kebab-case` with component prefix.

Budget, breakpoints, and focus rules: `_bmad-output/project-context.md` lines 62–71.

### Tera Templates

Key rules (`_bmad-output/project-context.md` lines 74–80):
- `{{ value | json_encode() }}` for inline JSON serialization
- Every `<head>` includes `{% include "partials/seo-head.html" %}` (meta, hreflang, Schema.org)
- Every `<body>` starts with `{% include "partials/skip-nav.html" %}`
- `{# Comment explains WHY, not WHAT #}`

### Accessibility (RGAA 4 AA — non-negotiable)

axe-core runs in CI — **zero violations required** (`ci.yml`). Full rules: `_bmad-output/project-context.md` lines 83–91.

Lighthouse CI gates are defined in `.lighthouserc.json` (performance >90, accessibility >95, best-practices >90, SEO >95).

### CI Workflows

| Workflow | Trigger | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `validate.yml` | push/PR on `content/providers/**` | YAML schema validation; posts result as PR comment |
| `ci.yml` | push/PR on templates, static, content | Build → axe-core ‖ Lighthouse (parallelised, shared artifact) |
| `build.yml` | push to `main` only | Deploy to GitHub Pages |

Deploy only happens on `main`. Never add deploy steps to `ci.yml`.

### Commit Format and Anti-Patterns

Commit format, scopes, and the full anti-pattern list: `_bmad-output/project-context.md` lines 95–114.

### Adding a New Provider (checklist)

1. Create `content/providers/{slug}/index.md` and `index.en.md` using `docs/provider-template.yaml`
2. Run `mise run validate` — must pass
3. Run `mise run build && mise run check` — must pass
4. Commit: `data(providers): add {provider-name}`
